description: Global map of Local Climate Zones is published by Global LCZ map research team. It describes a 100 m global Local Climate Zone map with 17 classes and links to a deposited dataset, Earth Engine and map-tile access. Spatial scope is global. Spatial detail: 100 m. The full data period remains unverified. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. The metadata lists TXT, PNG, TIF; these files were not downloaded. Licence: cc-by-4.0. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. The metadata establishes the resource, but its files, accuracy and dependency compatibility were not tested. This review identifies hazard exposure, capacity planning as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are data-copernicus-ghsl-built-up-population. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
